description: Whether this workspace's brand report goes to its client every week or month, to whom, and the last full period's email ready to send (latest: subject, a sentence from the numbers, and once its link is made the url, body and mailto). On by default once the brand has a client; each report is ready on the 1st (or Monday) at 9:00 in the workspace's timezone, and the team gets a push. Nothing is emailed by Chockstone: send latest.body yourself through the person's mail, or report_email_create makes the link first.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.
